components.name: Outlined Action
components.css: .ds-outlined-action { min-height: 42px; padding: 13px 18px 12px; border: 1px solid #151310; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: #151310; font: 650 0.61rem/1.5 sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 180ms; } .ds-outlined-action:hover, .ds-outlined-action:focus-visible { background: #151310; color: #f8f4eb; } .ds-outlined-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ad8955; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-outlined-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Dark Outlined Action
components.css: .ds-dark-action { min-height: 42px; padding: 13px 18px 12px; border: 1px solid #f8f4eb; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: #f8f4eb; font: 650 0.61rem/1.5 sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 180ms; } .ds-dark-action:hover, .ds-dark-action:focus-visible { background: #f8f4eb; color: #151310; } .ds-dark-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ad8955; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-dark-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Underlined editorial action without a container.
components.css: .ds-text-action { display: inline-flex; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; background: transparent; color: #151310; font: 650 0.61rem/1.5 sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: gap 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color 240ms; } .ds-text-action:hover, .ds-text-action:focus-visible { gap: 15px; color: #ad8955; } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ad8955; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Archive Navigation
components.description: Hairline desktop index with a bounded commission action.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 34px; color: #151310; font: 650 .66rem/1.5 sans-serif; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 9px 0; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 4px; left: 0; height: 1px; background: currentColor; content: ''; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; }

components.name: Publisher Bookplate
components.description: The precise nested-line identity mark used in the fixed header.
components.css: .ds-bookplate { position: relative; display: grid; width: 30px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid #151310; color: #151310; font: 500 .54rem/1 Georgia, serif; place-items: center; } .ds-bookplate::after { position: absolute; width: 20px; height: 28px; border: 1px solid currentColor; content: ''; opacity: .32; }

narrative.overview: The system treats a premium studio portfolio as a contemporary private press. Typography, physical book construction, restrained interface chrome, and one continuous architectural world make the metaphor functional rather than decorative. The mood is quiet, tactile, and exacting, with generous negative space interrupted by deliberate moments of editorial scale.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast publishing typography interrupted by a physical 3D volume.
Square precision, hairline rules, and almost no decorative rounding.
Warm neutral architecture with rare brass and project-specific binding colors.
Asymmetric composition at large sizes and simplified touch-first framing on mobile.
Reversible, scroll-controlled motion with semantic HTML always present.

rules.name: The Rare Metal Rule
rules.body: Brass stays below roughly 10% of a frame. Its scarcity is what makes foil and focus feel valuable.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bodoni speaks in titles and authored statements. Manrope handles every navigational, factual, and operational sentence.

rules.name: The Physical Depth Rule
rules.body: If a layer is not moving above another layer or representing a physical object, it does not receive a shadow.

dos: Do make the library metaphor functional: each project remains a selectable, inspectable volume.
Do preserve Library Parchment (#f0ece3), Printing Ink (#151310), and Aged Brass (#ad8955) as the global hierarchy.
Do use broad editorial type with narrow label copy and strong negative space.
Do keep camera roll at zero, FOV between 32 and 47 degrees, and local pointer motion under 7 degrees.
Do provide keyboard, touch, reduced-motion, and forced-fallback access to the same content.
donts: Don't turn the portfolio into a standard agency card grid with a decorative 3D hero.
Don't use literal Victorian, gothic, fantasy, Hogwarts, steampunk, or nostalgic old-book imagery.
Don't use generic black luxury styling, neon technology demos, futuristic HUDs, glassmorphism, or floating gradient blobs.
Don't imitate Stripe Press, copy its covers, or borrow Stripe branding.
Don't add Three.js spectacle that is disconnected from navigation or story.
Don't introduce template-driven SaaS hierarchy, excessive rounded cards, pills, or gratuitous scroll effects.
